title: Exact sparse spectrum concept class
statement: For natural numbers $n$ and $k$, the exact sparse spectrum concept class consists of the sign-valued Boolean functions on the $n$-dimensional cube for which the spectral sparsity of the associated $71$-valued function on the binary cube is at most $2^{k+1}$.
caveat: The definitions of spectral sparsity, the sign-value map, and the binary-cube/sign-cube correspondence are not supplied.
